root.name: Formation: Shy Attack
root.moves: 1. a3 e5 2. g3 d5 3. Bg2 Nf6 4. d3 Nc6 5. Nd2 Bd6 6. e3 O-O 7. h3

overview: White builds a fianchetto and e3-d3 set-up with 1.a3 as a waiting move, with g3, Bg2, d3, e3, Nd2 and h3, ready against almost any Black set-up. Black has taken the centre with ...e5 and ...d5 and develops with ...Nc6, ...Bd6 and ...O-O. The play is slow and manoeuvring, close to a reversed Hippopotamus or King's Indian structure.

white_ideas.idea: Play Bg2, d3, e3, Nd2 and h3, then expand with e4 or b4/c4.
Keep a flexible King's Indian Attack style set-up.

black_ideas.idea: Hold the centre with ...e5/...d5 and develop ...Nc6, ...Bd6, ...O-O.
Break with ...e4 or ...f5 depending on White's set-up.

typical_structures.structure: White pawns on a3/d3/e3/g3/h3 with Bg2 against a Black e5/d5 centre.

character.notes: A slow, safe set-up with few ways to lose quickly.

soundness.notes: Sound, though White concedes the centre.

structure.notes: Centre pawns not in contact, pieces fianchettoed.

approach.notes: A set-up played the same way against many Black replies.

level.notes: Clear plans but unusual; not a coach's first choice.
